title: Brotli compress large buffers
summary: Compress 4 to 214 KB buffers of text and mixed content with Brotli (quality 11 with a 22-bit window); compression only, no decompression.
notes: One operation compresses one in-memory buffer with Brotli and returns the compressed bytes. Decompression is left out of the timed call and used only by the verifier.
